rules.universe: top 100 Binance USDT-M perpetuals by the previous day's quote volume (stablecoins, wrapped tokens, index and metal contracts excluded)
rules.scans: every 15 minutes on closed candles, like the dashboard
rules.management: sell 1/(k+1) at TP1 (k = TP1 in R), then 4/7 of the rest at TP2 and the rest at TP3; the stop never moves
rules.sameCandle: stop assumed first; a fill and a target in the same candle takes no profit that candle
rules.resend: 12 h, and never while an earlier paper trade on the same setup is unresolved
rules.regime: setup RG (outside Krillin): BTC daily close above its daily MA100 = long, below = short; market at the 00:00 UTC close on each flip, exit at the next flip or a fixed stop 3 × daily ATR(14) from entry; R vs the same $50 risk
